craft_notes: Sthāyin: seat-joy. Close: making. Rejected: 'idol' — killed: mark kept; 'throne' — killed: seat kept.

lines: Flowers foremost, all in order — emblem or altar;
with fourteen mutterings, the flower-seat prepare.
l4.sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā
